name: orb_pullback_entry_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's 09:15-09:30 opening range is the overnight information absorption window — institutional participants absorb FII/DII flow, global cues, and order imbalance before committing to direction. When NIFTY breaks above the ORB high (confirmed across 3 consecutive 5-second bars, meaning 15 seconds of sustained close above the level), it signals institutional buy-side flow has overwhelmed the opening range's supply ceiling. These algorithmic buyers — predominantly VWAP-benchmarked programs — temporarily exhaust their upside order queue, allowing a pullback to the ORB level. At the ORB high level, resting buy orders from the same institutions (who treat the breakout level as a cost-basis anchor) absorb fresh selling; a 5-second bar whose low touches the ORB high but whose close holds above it signals this absorption is complete. The next institutional wave then drives a 15-30 spot point continuation within 30-90 seconds — capturing the second leg of the breakout rather than the first.

indicators.name: orb_high_15
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window — the 09:15-09:30 ORB is the same 15 minutes regardless of bar size. At 5-second bars, this is exactly 180 bars. NOT scaled from original because this is a FIXED TIME WINDOW, not a rolling lookback.

indicators.name: orb_low_15
indicators.purpose: Fixed time window — same rationale as orb_high_15. The opening range low is an absolute boundary defined by the 09:15-09:30 window, not a rolling measure.

indicators.name: bull_breakout_confirmed
indicators.formula: count of consecutive 5s bars with close > orb_high >= 3
indicators.purpose: 3 consecutive 5-second bars (15 seconds) confirming breakout. Same as original's 3-bar confirmation at 1-minute, but at 5s. A 15-second sustained close above ORB high on NIFTY eliminates spurious 5-second spikes driven by momentary illiquidity, while remaining fast enough to detect institutional breakout momentum before price extends too far for a meaningful pullback.

indicators.name: bear_breakout_confirmed
indicators.formula: count of consecutive 5s bars with close < orb_low >= 3
indicators.purpose: Same 15-second confirmation for bearish ORB breakout — eliminates 5-second false dips below ORB low.

indicators.name: pullback_to_orb_high
indicators.formula: abs(low - orb_high) / orb_high <= 0.05% AND close > orb_high
indicators.purpose: Role reversal detection — low touches ORB high (within 0.05% tolerance = ~12 spot pts on NIFTY at 24000) but close holds above, signaling institutional buy orders absorbing the pullback at the ORB level. Tolerance calibrated to ~0.05% which is approximately 1 lot-size of slippage, not a wider band that would include mid-range bars.

indicators.name: pullback_to_orb_low
indicators.formula: abs(high - orb_low) / orb_low <= 0.05% AND close < orb_low
indicators.purpose: Bearish role reversal — high touches ORB low but close holds below, signaling seller defense of the ORB breakdown level.

indicators.name: pullback_recency
indicators.purpose: 150 bars = 12.5 minutes post-breakout window. Original used 30 minutes (30 bars at 1-min). Compressed to 12.5 minutes because at 5s bars we can detect the pullback earlier — institutional VWAP algorithms that drive NIFTY pullbacks typically complete their reversal to the ORB level within 5-10 minutes of the breakout, not 30 minutes. Pullbacks taking longer indicate weak breakout momentum; the entry thesis weakens significantly after 12 minutes.

conditions: bull_breakout_confirmed: close was above orb_high for 3+ consecutive 5s bars (at some point in current day after 09:30)
pullback_recency: pullback occurs within 150 bars (12.5 min) of breakout confirmation
pullback_to_orb_high: current bar's low touches orb_high ± 0.05% AND close stays above orb_high (support test passed)
vix_filter: India VIX between 12 and 22 (stable regime for ORB patterns)
time_filter: 09:30-11:00 IST (pullbacks outside morning session are less reliable)
buy_ce.confirmation: The current 5-second bar touches the ORB high on its low but closes above — institutional bid is present at the ORB level, absorbing selling pressure.

conditions: bear_breakout_confirmed: close was below orb_low for 3+ consecutive 5s bars
pullback_recency: within 150 bars of breakdown confirmation
pullback_to_orb_low: current bar's high touches orb_low ± 0.05% AND close stays below orb_low (resistance test passed)
buy_pe.confirmation: Current 5-second bar tests ORB low as resistance (high touches, close stays below) — institutional sellers defending the breakdown level.

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points (≈6 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If the ORB level fails as support/resistance within the first few bars after entry, the institutional buy orders have been overwhelmed — the role reversal thesis is invalidated. NIFTY at 24000 moves 6 spot points in under 10 seconds during volatile sessions, but 6 spot points of pullback below the ORB high means the breakdown is genuine, not a test. At 30s hold, the reference table shows 2-5 option pts typical moves; a 3-pt stop allows the trade the full typical move range before stopping.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points (≈12 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). After a pullback bounce from the ORB level, the continuation leg on NIFTY typically extends 15-30 spot points — this is the same institutional flow wave that drove the original breakout, now unimpeded. Targeting 6 option pts captures roughly the lower half of that range (12-15 spot points) at 1:2 risk-reward with the 3-pt stop. This is conservative: many continuation legs extend further, but the time-stop at 90 seconds limits capture anyway.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 12 and 22 — below 12 means very low vol environment where ORB ranges are tiny and pullbacks are unreliable; above 22 means high vol where ORB levels break frequently and role reversal fails
filters.time_filter: entries only 09:30-11:00 IST — pullback must occur in the first 90 minutes after market open when institutional flow drives NIFTY; later pullbacks to ORB level are mechanically valid but driven by retail, not institutional flow
filters.volume_filter: none explicitly — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5-second frequency; the 3-bar breakout confirmation serves as implicit momentum filter
filters.trend_filter: pullback direction aligns with breakout direction by construction
filters.spread_filter: limit order execution — no spread cost in this pipeline

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — ORB levels are widely watched; if too many participants pile into pullback entries at the exact ORB level, the pattern can fail as stop-hunters target the precise level

adaptation_notes: Original strategy: 1-minute bars on NIFTY50 constituent stocks, hold 20-150 minutes, entering at ORB level via limit order. Key changes: (1) Moved from constituent stocks to NIFTY index itself — this is cleaner because ORB patterns on indices are driven by institutional flow with higher predictability than single stocks; (2) Compressed hold time to 30-90 seconds — we capture only the FIRST leg of the continuation, not the full swing; (3) Entry timing shifted to 09:30-11:00 from 09:35-11:00 because at 5s resolution we see pullbacks begin immediately after the ORB window closes; (4) Pullback window compressed from 30 minutes to 12.5 minutes — at 5s bars, institutional pullbacks on NIFTY complete much faster than on individual stocks; (5) Stops/targets converted from percentage-of-ORB-range to fixed option points calibrated to 30-90 second expected moves.
weaknesses: ~30% of NIFTY ORB breakouts never pull back to the ORB level — the entire session's opportunity is missed for those days
The pullback may be the beginning of a full breakdown through the ORB level, making the 'support test' a bull trap — most common during high-VIX sessions already partially filtered

At 5-second granularity, the pullback_to_orb condition can trigger on multiple consecutive bars as price oscillates near the ORB level, generating multiple entries on the same pullback (max_trades_per_day=3 limits this)
ORB range is tiny on low-volatility days (under 20 NIFTY points) — pullback tolerance of 0.05% is 12 pts, which may exceed the actual ORB range, making the signal degenerate
